interface: Internal immutable snapshots; not task CRUD JSON. HTTP preview uses original task_index and local clocks.

time.birth_scale: UTC; unknown birth time is 12:00 UTC
time.local_day: IANA zone; DST may give 23/25 hours
time.grid_anchor: local work_start; ceil now in elapsed UTC time
time.duration: exact elapsed minutes; whole tasks only

energy.samples: 15-minute midpoint pieces, exact shorter last piece; UTC elapsed time

selection.tie: strictly greater score replaces best; exact tie keeps earliest UTC start; no rounding before selection
selection.optimality: deterministic greedy, not a global optimum

constraints.break_rule: maximum applicable break, not sum; lunch/rest can fulfill it
constraints.deadline: inclusive local calendar date -> exclusive next local midnight

load.phase_reference: local noon; earlier occurrence if repeated
load.capacity: floor((elapsed work minutes - union of system intervals) * load_factor)

moves.eligible: critical source; unpinned/unstarted intellectual or physical; high priority OR duration >= 60; deadline permits
moves.target: nearest explicitly known working noncritical day, relevant noon cycle >= 0, whole task and every resident task fit
moves.advice: prefers confirmed cycle >= 0.5, otherwise nearest; never mutates dates
moves.persistence: source + accepted future_plans in one transaction

replan.boundary: saved start == now counts as begun; end == now is past
replan.skipped: retain elapsed history visually; exclude from load and fatigue
replan.history_edits: missing historical snapshots or incompatible duration/start changes fail
